caption: Attribute Dictionary
description: The Attribute Dictionary defines schema attributes and includes references to the events and objects in which they are used.
name: dictionary

associated_lineage.caption: Process Lineage
associated_lineage.description: The lineage of the process, represented by a list of paths for each ancestor process.

context_summary.caption: Context Summary
context_summary.description: A summary of the context in which the event occurred.

destination_address.caption: Destination Address
destination_address.description: The destination IP address associated with a network endpoint.

event_data.caption: Event Data
event_data.description: The event data associated with the technique.  Varies by technique.

evidences.caption: Evidence Artifacts
evidences.description: A collection of evidence artifacts associated to the activity/activities that triggered a finding. See specific usage.

detection_context.caption: Detection Contexts
detection_context.description: Interesting facts about source process execution context, e.g. viaAutoStart, viaDllSideload.

detection_type.caption: Detection Type
detection_type.description: The type of the detection, or detector, e.g. Behavioral, VDL, HMPA, AMSI.

depth.caption: Depth
depth.description: The depth of the process in the process lineage (e.g.)

device.caption: Device
device.description: An addressable device, computer system or host.

download_url.caption: Source URL
download_url.description: The URL from which an entity was downloaded.

event_time_usec.caption: Event Time
event_time_usec.description: The time of the event in microseconds since the epoch.

host_id.caption: Host ID
host_id.description: Unique identifier for the host where the event originated; preferably a uuid.

indicator_type.caption: Indicator Type
indicator_type.description: The type of indicator associated with the event.

ingest_time_usec.caption: Ingest Time
ingest_time_usec.description: The time the event was ingested in microseconds since the epoch.

insights.caption: Insights
insights.description: Interesting facts about source process, e.g. Unsigned, Suspicious_Execution_Path, Persistence_Context.

ioc_events.caption: IOC Events
ioc_events.description: The list of IOC events associated with the event.

normalizer.caption: Normalizer
normalizer.description: The normalizer that generated the event.

normalizer_revision.caption: Normalizer Revision
normalizer_revision.description: The version of the normalizer that generated the event.

normalizer_version.caption: Normalizer Version
normalizer_version.description: The version of the normalizer that generated the event.

original_data.caption: Original Data
original_data.description: Original, unadulterated data prior to any transformation.

primary_ttp.caption: Primary TTP
primary_ttp.description: The primary TTP associated with the runtime technique.

process_correlation_id.caption: Process Correlation ID
process_correlation_id.description: The correlation ID associated with the process.

process_create_time_usec.caption: Process Create Time
process_create_time_usec.description: The time the process was created in microseconds since the epoch.

process_id.caption: Process ID
process_id.description: Identifier provided by the OS for the running process.

process_image_path.caption: Process Image Path
process_image_path.description: Full path to the process binary.

ml_score.caption: ML Score
ml_score.description: The machine learning score associated with the process.

local_rep.caption: Local Reputation
local_rep.description: The local reputation score associated with the process.

local_rep_signers.caption: Local Reputation Signers
local_rep_signers.description: The local reputation signers associated with the process.

pua_score.caption: PUA Score
pua_score.description: The potentially unwanted application score associated with the process.

global_rep.caption: Global Reputation
global_rep.description: The global reputation score associated with the process.

resource_id.caption: Taegis Event UID
resource_id.description: A identifier used for all events in the Taegis system.

runtime_iocs.caption: Runtime IOCs
runtime_iocs.description: The runtime IOCs associated with the event.

runtime_techniques.caption: Runtime Techniques
runtime_techniques.description: The runtime techniques associated with the event.

sensor_type.caption: Sensor Type
sensor_type.description: The type of sensor that generated the event.

source_address.caption: Source Address
source_address.description: The source IP address associated with a network endpoint.

sophos_ep.caption: Sophos Endpoint Detection Attributes.
sophos_ep.description: Specific detection attributes coming from Sophos endpoints.

sophos_pid.caption: Sophos Process ID
sophos_pid.description: The Sophos process ID associated with the event.

sophos_tid.caption: Sophos Thread ID
sophos_tid.description: The Sophos thread ID associated with the event.

process.caption: Initiating Process
process.description: The target process associated with the event.

sensor_cpe.caption: Sensor CPE
sensor_cpe.description: The Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) identifier for the sensor.

sensor_event_id.caption: Sensor Event ID
sensor_event_id.description: Event ID of original_data assigned by the sensor.

sensor_version.caption: Sensor Version
sensor_version.description: The version of the sensor that generated the event.

tenant_id.caption: Taegis Platform Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: The ID of the Taegis platform tenant associated with this event.

threat_source_id.caption: Threat Source ID
threat_source_id.description: The identifier of the threat source.

threat_type.caption: Threat Type
threat_type.description: The type of threat associated with the event.

time_nanos.caption: Event Time in Nanoseconds
time_nanos.description: The time of the event in nanoseconds since the epoch.

vendor_attributes.caption: Vendor Attributes
vendor_attributes.description:
The Vendor Attributes object can be used to represent values of attributes populated by the Vendor/Finding Provider. It can help distinguish between the vendor-prodvided values and consumer-updated values, of key attributes like severity_id.
The original finding producer should not populate this object. It should be populated by consuming systems that support data mutability.

types.caption: Data Types
types.description: The data types available in OCSF. Each data type specifies constraints in the form regular expressions, max lengths or value limits. Implementors of OCSF should ensure they abide to these constraints.

timestamp_nanos_t.caption: Timestamp with nanosecond precision
timestamp_nanos_t.description:
The timestamp format is the number of nanoseconds since the Epoch 01/01/1970 00:00:00 UTC. For example:
1737642869398696192.
